business_summary: MEISEI INDUSTRIAL Co.,Ltd. operates as a construction works company in Japan, Asia, and internationally. The company operates through two segments, Construction Work Business and Boiler Business. It offers hot and cold insulation systems, including the Keical-Ace Super-Silica, which is used in various fields as a primary hot insulation material; the Keical-Ace Win for rust prevention of heat-insulated objects; and the Recycal, developed for energy saving and resource-recycling. The company also undertakes liquefied natural (LNG) gas and petroleum gas-related insulation works comprising on-site liquefaction equipment, low-temperature liquefaction carriers, and domestic storage facilities; furnace and refractory insulation works for industrial furnaces, incinerators, and boiler ducts; thermal insulation; and insulation works for nuclear power plants. In addition, it provides fireproofing products, such as Pyrocrete 241, a cement-based fireproofing material; Thermolag 3000, an epoxy-type fireproofing material; Mandoseal; and Fendolite M II Marine Mandolite 25/40. Further, the company is involved in the repair and reinforcement of concrete structures; construction of incinerator facilities; repair of stack linings; and provision of acoustic insulation products. Additionally, it offers various materials used in insulation-related work, such as processed polyurethane foams, insulation panels for LNG carriers, molded polyurethane foams, metal insulation, light anti-corrosion coatings, and calcium silicate insulation materials; Grapple Zinc Primer, a heavy-duty anticorrosion coating for steel structures; and ULVA Shield, a polymeric rubber sheet for the thermal insulation of piping, vessels, and equipment. MEISEI INDUSTRIAL Co.,Ltd. was founded in 1944 and is headquartered in Osaka, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 메이세이산업(주) 일본, 아시아 및 국제적으로 건설 회사로 운영되고 있습니다. 이 회사는 건설공사 사업과 보일러 사업이라는 두 가지 부문으로 운영됩니다. 다양한 분야에서 1차 단열재로 사용되는 Keical-Ace Super-Silica를 포함한 냉온단열 시스템을 제공합니다. 단열 물체의 녹 방지를 위한 Keical-Ace Win; 그리고 에너지 절약과 자원 재활용을 위해 개발된 리사이클(Recycal)도 있습니다. 이 회사는 또한 현장 액화 장비, 저온 액화 운반선 및 국내 저장 시설로 구성된 액화 천연(LNG) 가스 및 석유 가스 관련 단열 작업을 수행합니다. 산업용 용광로, 소각로 및 보일러 덕트용 용광로 및 내화 단열 작업; 단열; 원자력 발전소의 단열 작업. 또한 시멘트계 내화재인 Pyrocrete 241; 에폭시계 내화재인 Thermolag 3000; 만도실; 및 Fendolite M II Marine Mandolite 25/40. 또한 회사는 콘크리트 구조물의 수리 및 보강에 참여하고 있습니다. 소각시설 건설
